overview: Forge Row is the industrial backbone of Katta Castellum, producing metal goods, reinforced materials, and arcane‑infused components.
history: Established to centralize heavy crafting and metalwork.
Arcane forges were introduced to improve alloy quality.
Guild oversight ensures safe operation of high‑heat forges.
The district expanded to support Artisan Row and the Armory Quarter.
hooks: A forge overheats, threatening a chain reaction.
A shipment of refined alloy goes missing.
A guild inspector requests assistance verifying forge safety.
Arcane forge tools begin malfunctioning across the district.
